machine_action_rules: Treat only source_latin as editable Interslavic language canon.
Never edit source_cyrillic as an independent translation; regenerate it from authenticated Latin sources and the reviewed role manifest.
Do not edit the German authority from this language lane.
Append a source-pinned decision with evidence and rejected alternatives for every material Latin linguistic change.
Preserve mathematics, TeX syntax, complete foreign identities, citations, Roman structures, style surfaces, and one-letter roles according to the reviewed role manifest.

After a Latin change: replay and verify the editorial ledger, rerun the complete role census, derive Cyrillic twice, prove that every delta is licensed, build both scripts serially, and rerun text, math, TeX, font, link, and changed-page visual QA.
Do not silently reuse v020 role decisions when source hashes or locators drift; fail closed and review the affected records again.
Do not claim native-speaker, community, official-standard, or scholarly-peer-review certification without an authentic receipt.
